These examples show concrete inventory documents and API sketches using the DASDAE metadata model.

## Inventory Examples

- [Quickstart](quickstart.qmd): turn a channel-coordinate table and the instrument settings into a minimal, valid inventory.
- [Simple Inventory](simple-inventory.qmd): build a small inventory for a trenched and surface-laid fiber deployment.
- [NORFOX](norfox.qmd): model a five-arm fiber-optic deployment as five arm fiber arrays with multiple cables, pipe enclosures, loop closures, KML-derived geometry, and co-located NORES stations.
